newsitem.title: GERMANY: PWA - restructuring to help 97 performance.
newsitem.headline: PWA - restructuring to help 97 performance.

text.p: German paper manufacturer PWA Papierwerke Waldhof Aschaffenburg AG said on Tuesday that it expected the first substantial improvement from its restructuring process to show through in 1997.

PWA also announced a 1996 group net profit of 227 million marks versus 163 million in the previous year, and said its profit per share according to DVFA accounting rules was 21 marks in 1996 versus 25 marks previously.
With the expected improvement from restructuring, PWA would in 1997 come a step nearer to its target of achieving sustained earnings strength, the firm said in a statement.
But PWA added that the development in prices celulose and recycled paper remained uncertain.
